name: Emperor Kuze
source:
[i]"Perhaps I will visit your room tonight... but don't misunderstand."[/i]

Emperor Kuze has rebuilt a crumbling empire and regained his imperial powers, and he is a perfectionist - treating everyone with strictness, including himself. Perhaps he had many enemies inside the court, and he never gets a chance to relax.

But Sakuhito tells me that, in truth, he is a warm and gentle person. It seems that there are other reason for him not displaying his emotions.

[[url=https://shall-we-date.fandom.com/wiki/Emperor_Kuze]From Hinata's notes[/url]]
